tool.name: impg partition
tool.description: splits a cohort into windowed homologous loci
tool.command: @SETUP_ALIGNMENTS@ #if str($out.format) == "fasta" #set $sequence_files = $out.sequence_files #else #set $sequence_files = [] #end if @SETUP_SEQUENCE_FILES@ mkdir -p outdir && impg partition @ALIGNMENT_ARGS@ -w $window_size -d '$merge_distance' -o $out.format --output-folder outdir #if str($out.format) == "bed" and str($out.bed_mode) == "separate" --separate-files #end if #if str($out.format) == "fasta" --separate-files @SEQUENCE_FILE_ARGS@ $out.reverse_complement #end if --selection-mode $selection_mode $partition_opts.no_rehome_singletons --min-missing-size $partition_opts.min_missing_size --min-boundary-distance $partition_opts.min_boundary_distance #if $partition_opts.starting_sequences_file --starting-sequences-file '$partition_opts.starting_sequences_file' #end if $transitive.transitive_dfs -m $transitive.max_depth --min-transitive-len $transitive.min_transitive_len --min-distance-between-ranges $transitive.min_distance_between_ranges $filtering.approximate #if str($filtering.min_result_identity).strip() --min-result-identity $filtering.min_result_identity #end if $filtering.no_merge @CMD_INDEX_OPTS@ @THREADS@

param.label: Window size (bp)
param.help: Window size for partitioning. impg greedily covers each sequence with windows of this size and groups homologous regions across the cohort.

param.name: format
param.label: Output format
param.option: fasta — one sequence file per partition

param.label: Selection mode
param.help: Strategy for picking the next starting sequence when partitioning.
param.option: longest — sequence with the longest single missing region
total — sequence with the highest total missing regions
sample — PanSN sample with the highest total missing regions
haplotype — PanSN haplotype with the highest total missing regions

param.label: Min boundary distance
param.help: Regions closer than this to a sequence start/end are extended to the boundaries.

param.label: Disable singleton rehoming
param.help: Disable post-partition reassignment of singleton sliver partitions to their flanking partition.

param.name: starting_sequences_file
param.label: Starting sequences file
param.help: File of sequence names (one per line) to start partitioning from.

param.label: Use DFS instead of BFS
param.help: Depth-first search returns fewer, less overlapping results but is slower. (Partition always walks the transitive closure.)

param.label: Approximate mode
param.help: Faster queries for tracepoint files (.1aln/.tpa); only bed output.

tool.help:
**impg partition** — split a cohort into windowed homologous loci
Walks the implicit alignment graph with fixed-size windows and partitions the cohort into comparable loci, so each partition can be processed independently (e.g. by `pggb` or `minigraph-cactus`). Output is a BED table (one row per sequence per partition, with the partition id in column 4) or one FASTA per partition.
-----
**Input**
- One or more PAF files (optionally bgzipped). - **Window size** (bp): the partitioning window. - **Merge distance** (required): the largest internal gap/SV one query hop can absorb into one partition interval.
**Output**
- **bed, single file**: one BED file with all partitions (column 4 = partition id). - **bed, one file per partition**: a list collection of `partitionN.bed` files. - **fasta**: a list collection of `partitionN.fasta` files (requires sequence files).
**Selection mode** picks the next starting sequence: `longest` (default), `total`, or by PanSN `sample`/`haplotype`.
